title: NativeRefinementParent
description: Exact recorded ancestry of the one explicitly selected parent level.

evidence.description: Original admitted parent run/span/root, never a resealed projection.

level.description: Explicit parent level; no default or prefix inference.

model.description: Actual semantic identity of that selected level.

package.description: Exact parent file identity, not just its model values.

source.description: Parent's recorded original observation, not official source authentication.

EvidenceReference.description: Evidence ancestry reference, not a self-approved quality/release verdict.

root.description: BLAKE3 evidence root, not a blob id or package digest.

run.description: Run identity of the evidence producer.

ModelId.description: Content identity for one Tritium model level, not its package or provenance.

OriginalSourceId.description: Candidate identity of original named tensor/asset content, not fitted content or provenance.

PackageId.description: Content identity for a Tritium package.
